# Upstream material

`../schemas/upstream/agent-plugins/1.0.0/` contains unmodified Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas and their upstream licensing information from [agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec](https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec). Exact provenance and file integrity are recorded in the root `agent-depot.lock.json`; the selection is declared in `agent-depot.json`.

Schemas are software material under Apache-2.0. Copyright remains with the upstream authors. The preserved `LICENSE.md` explains the separate treatment of documentation and software. Agent Depot's own code is MIT licensed.
